entries.title: I Corinthians 3:1
segments: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, as unto babes in Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:2
segments: I fed you with milk, not with meat; for ye were not yet able [to bear it]: nay, not even now are ye able;

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:3
segments: for ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you jealousy and strife, are ye not carnal, and do ye not walk after the manner of men?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:4
segments: For when one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not men?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:5
segments: What then is Apollos? and what is Paul? Ministers through whom ye believed; and each as the Lord gave to him.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:6
segments: I planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:7
segments: So then neither is he that planteth anything, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:8
segments: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: but each shall receive his own reward according to his own labor.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:9
segments: For we are God's fellow-workers: ye are God's husbandry, God's building.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:10
segments: According to the grace of God which was given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder I laid a foundation; and another buildeth thereon. But let each man take heed how he buildeth thereon.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:11
segments: For other foundation can no man lay than that which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:12
segments: But if any man buildeth on the foundation gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, stubble;

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:13
segments: each man's work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself shall prove each man's work of what sort it is.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:14
segments: If any man's work shall abide which he built thereon, he shall receive a reward.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:15
segments: If any man's work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as through fire.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:16
segments: Know ye not that ye are a temple of God, and [that] the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:17
segments: If any man destroyeth the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, and such are ye.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:18
segments: Let no man deceive himself. If any man thinketh that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he may become wise.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:19
segments: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He that taketh the wise in their craftiness:

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:20
segments: and again, The Lord knoweth the reasonings of the wise that they are vain.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:21
segments: Wherefore let no one glory in men. For all things are yours;

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:22
segments: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:23
segments: and ye are Christ's; and Christ is God's.
